gate355Identity.name: Пункты взимания платы 355 км М-4
gate355Identity.conclusion: 357 address does not alone indicate a wrong355 point; named organization confirms nearby location.

limitations: All24 sums are approximate whole-Yandex-route amounts, not official receipts or verified fare cells.
Directions are independently observed; do not mirror.
Near355 routes show entry/exit maneuvers and, on south-to355 routes, explicit U-turn; same first/last paid boundaries not established.
Existing24 unsupported355 matrix cells remain unknown; not declared impossible routes.
Full provider geometry/plaza traversal not exported from Yandex; compact visible DOM-derived observations persisted, not full raw browser snapshots/screenshots.
